title: 341_110448_Records_Relating_to_the_Collection_and_Dissemination_of_Intelligence_1948-1955-TS_CONT_No.2_2-5300-2-5399
doc_notes: This document is a collection of Top Secret and Confidential intelligence reports from the U.S. Air Force in Europe (USAFE) dated November 1948, concerning unidentified aircraft and radar intelligence.

incidents.summary: Unidentified aircraft sighted by three crews of the 307th Bomb Group off the west coast of Holland.
incidents.quote: Unidentified aircraft was sighted by three crews of the group at 1402Z 5 Sep 48 off west coast of Holland

incidents.summary: A flying saucer was observed hovering over Neubiberg Air Base.
incidents.quote: one was observed hovering over Neubiberg Air Base for about thirty minutes

incidents.summary: A flying saucer observed by a Swedish technical expert near a lake, resulting in a crater on the lake floor.
incidents.quote: The object crashed or landed in the lake and he carefully noted its azimuth
